{{nutritionsummary|1/5 of recipe (400 g)|5|173|80|8.9 g|1.1 g|5 mg|2913 mg|20.7 g|8.9 g|14.2 g|2.5 g|67%|21%|9%|12%}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Rice|Rice]] | [[Cookbook:Fried rice|Fried rice]]

==Ingredients==

* 2 packs (8 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]./800 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]/1.8 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]]) [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrots]], cut into {{convert/3|5|x|1|x|1|cm|in|abbr=on}} pieces
* 1 pack ({{convert|200|g|oz|abbr=on|disp=s}}) [[Cookbook:Bean Sprout|bean sprouts]], soaked in hot water and drained
* 1 pack ({{convert|200|g|oz|abbr=on|disp=s}}) [[Cookbook:Broccoli|broccoli florets]], soaked in hot water and drained
* 1 pack ({{convert|200|g|oz|abbr=on|disp=s}}) [[Cookbook:Mushroom|mushrooms]], quartered and soaked in hot water
* ½ pack ({{convert|250|g|oz|abbr=on|disp=s}}) [[Cookbook:Cabbage|cabbage]], cut into {{convert|2|cm|in|abbr=on}} pieces
* 4 [[Cookbook:Scallion|scallions]], cut into {{convert|1.5|cm|in|abbr=on}} pieces
* 3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Oil|corn oil]]
* 3 cloves [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]]
* ¼ big [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* 1 cup ({{convert|100|g|oz|abbr=on|disp=s}}) cooked [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]]
* 2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 1½ tbsp light [[Cookbook:Soy sauce|soy sauce]]
* 1 tbsp vegetarian [[Cookbook:Oyster sauce|oyster sauce]] substitute (or omit)
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]]

==Procedure==

# Heat the oil in a [[Cookbook:Non-stick|non-stick]] [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|pan]], add onion and garlic, and [[Cookbook:Stir-frying|stir-fry]] for 25 seconds until fragrant.
# Add the rice, all the vegetables, some salt, light soy sauce, oyster sauce and pepper. Stir until mixed well.
# Serve.
